summary: End-to-end testing of PJOK KBB teacher performance assessment app. Backend: 34/34 pytest tests pass covering auth (login admin/pengawas/kepsek/guru, wrong password 401, /auth/me), dashboard stats per role, users CRUD with persistence + self-delete protection + duplicate email + non-admin 403, schools CRUD + RBAC, teachers RBAC (admin sees all=3, guru self=1, kepsek school=2, pengawas wilayah=2), supervisors/principals RBAC, permissions list (28 rows = 4 roles x 7 menus) + admin-only update, guru profile/me. Frontend: login page renders with Indonesian branding, wrong password shows 'Email atau kata sandi salah' toast, admin login redirects to dashboard with all 5 stat cards (Total Sekolah=2, Guru=3, Pengawas=1, Kepsek=1, User Aktif=6), admin sidebar shows all 7 menus (dashboard/users/sekolah/guru/pengawas/kepsek/permissions), Manajemen Pengguna page loads with add-user-button and 6 users listed, Data Sekolah loads with seeded SDN Lembang/Cisarua, Pengaturan Hak Akses shows tabs (Administrator/Pengawas/Kepala Sekolah/Guru) with checkbox matrix, logout via profile-dropdown-trigger -> logout-button returns to /login. Guru login correctly hides menu-users, menu-permissions, menu-pengawas, menu-kepsek.

issues: Console warning: 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component' originating from Login. Likely a setState called during render (e.g. navigate() called unconditionally inside component body instead of inside useEffect when already authenticated). Not blocking but should be fixed to avoid React 18 strict-mode noise.

action_items: Optional: fix React render-time navigate() in Login.jsx (wrap redirect-when-already-logged-in inside useEffect) to silence the 'Cannot update a component while rendering' warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~700 lines — acceptable but trending toward needing modularization (split routers per resource: auth, users, schools, teachers, supervisors, principals, permissions).

CORS allow_credentials=False but the spec uses Bearer token in Authorization header (not cookies), so that's actually correct and consistent with the auth_testing playbook NOT applying (no httpOnly cookies in this implementation — token in localStorage instead, which is acceptable for the JWT+Bearer approach).
No brute-force lockout / rate limiting on /api/auth/login — playbook mentions 5-fail lockout. Acceptable for tahap pertama MVP but flag as future hardening.
seed_admin is idempotent and updates the admin password if changed — good (matches playbook).
bcrypt hash format verified ($2b$) via successful login flow.
All endpoints use /api prefix, env vars sourced correctly, no hardcoded URLs.
seed_data_creation: Seed produced by backend startup: 2 schools (SDN Lembang 01, SDN Cisarua 02), 1 admin, 1 pengawas (wilayah Lembang), 1 kepsek (SDN Lembang 01), 3 guru. 28 role_permissions rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase-1 acceptance criteria pass. Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers 34 cases across 8 classes (Auth, DashboardStats, Users, Schools, Teachers, SupervisorsPrincipals, Permissions, Profile). Re-run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. For next iterations adding penilaian/observasi modules, extend with new test classes.
